name: Australian Zoning Atlas
note: The first nation-wide map classifying and comparing residential planning controls across Australia, covering eight capital cities. Standardised data loading and analysis across all states and territories. Built with Jonathan O'Brien and Ethan Gilbert, for YIMBY Melbourne and the Australasian Housing and Land Economics Initiative.

name: The Next 25
note: Lead author. An open-data model ranking which 25 Melbourne train stations should be prioritised for the Activity Centre Program, scoring the 130 stations within 25km of the CBD on measures including peak service frequency and spare capacity.

name: Missing Middle Street Trees
note: Lead author. An open-data project tracking tree canopy across Melbourne, describing coverage by socioeconomic status and region, with a model for increasing urban greenery.
